headline: Same name. Different company.
text:
Headline: Same name. Different company.
Supporting line: Clone firms copy a regulated broker's name, logo and licence number. Match the website to the register.
Footer: Spot the clone before it spots you.
caption: Clone firms copy a real broker's name, logo and licence number, then change one thing: the website and bank details. Match the URL and phone on the regulator's register before you trust it.
